title: Speedometer Live Wallpaper: GPS Car Dashboard for Android
description: Turn your Android home screen into a car dashboard: 19 live wallpaper styles with real gauges for GPS speed, battery watts, CPU, RAM, signal and Wi-Fi.

@graph.name: Speedometer Live Wallpaper
@graph.description: A live wallpaper that turns your Android home screen into a car dashboard, in 19 styles from a 1960s walnut dashboard to a fighter jet's head-up display: a big gauge for power, CPU clock or GPS speed, with battery, RAM, signal and Wi-Fi gauges. Classic, Steel and Graphite are free; every other style is a one-time purchase of €2.39 with VAT in most of the euro area, or comes with the Speedometer Plus subscription.

intro.title: A speedometer that really moves
intro.lede: A live wallpaper with real gauges. The big dial shows power, CPU clock or your GPS speed. Around it: battery, memory, signal and Wi-Fi, with warning lights and a digital clock.
intro.caption: The needle follows the digits, as it does on your home screen.

sections.title: Rendered by the app itself

items: Install Speedometer Live Wallpaper from Google Play.
Open it and tap Set as wallpaper, then confirm on your home screen.
Open Styles and pick one of 19 dashboards and its layout. Customize sets its big gauge, units, clock, lights and colours.

sections.title: One dial, three jobs
sections.intro: Pick the mode in a style's settings, tap the gauge on your home screen, or use the Big gauge tile in Quick Settings, which switches it on every phone, Samsung's included. The digits above the needle show the same value.

sections.title: 19 dashboards to choose from
sections.intro: Classic, Steel and Graphite are free. Every other style is €2.39, once (with VAT in most of the euro area; Google Play shows yours), or comes with Speedometer Plus, a monthly or yearly subscription for every style, including the styles still to come, and no ads. Each style brings its own layouts. Tap one to try it live in your browser.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets each style's colours, glow, background and needle feel, and its own big gauge, units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts, and ready-made ones work in every style. Build your own in the layout builder: add the widgets you want, drag and resize them, lock the ones you've placed and pinch to zoom in, then save it or share it in the layout market.

items.title: Music on the dashboard
items.text: Future shows the song that's playing, its cover and the volume, and your missed calls and unread messages, with notification access. Nothing it reads leaves your phone.

items.title: Buy once, keep it
items.text: On a new phone with the same Google account, the styles you bought come back by themselves.

sections.title: 42 widgets for any style
sections.intro: Every style shows every widget, each in its own look. Add the ones you want in the layout builder: each one reads only while it's on your wallpaper, and only the weather sends anything, your rough location, rounded to about 10 km, to MET Norway for the forecast.

items.title: Gauges
items.text: The main gauge, battery, RAM, signal, Wi-Fi and link speed, temperature, the warning and shift lights, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi icons, an info display or strip, and a backplate for the dials to sit on.

items.title: On the road
items.text: Trip distance, average and top speed, drive time, a trip computer, a 0–100 timer, G-force, the odometer and climb rate, from GPS and the phone's own sensors. Nothing leaves your phone.

items.title: Where you are
items.text: Heading, altitude and tilt, sunrise and sunset, the moon, the weather and the air pressure.

items.title: Your day and your phone
items.text: The clock, the date and a second clock, your next alarm and event, Now Playing with music buttons and volume, calls and messages, steps today, battery time, data speed and storage.

sections.title: Layouts made by drivers
sections.intro: Players build their own dashboards in the app and share them in the layout market. Every layout works with every style, and each one here is drawn by the app itself.

items.title: Big gauge tile
items.text: Add the Big gauge tile to Quick Settings to switch the dial's mode from anywhere. Its subtitle shows the mode it's in.

items.title: Easy on the battery
items.text: Saver, Balanced or Smooth: the gauges redraw only while a needle moves, and nothing runs while the wallpaper is hidden. Android's Battery saver switches to Saver.

items.title: No ads on your wallpaper
items.text: A small banner shows inside the app only, never on your home screen.

items.title: Android only
items.text: Live wallpapers are an Android feature, so there's no iPhone version.

band.title: Try every style in your browser
band.text: The real wallpaper runs on the page: pick a style and a layout, change the settings and tap the big gauge. No install needed.

sections.title: What every gauge shows
sections.intro: On the Classic dashboard: tap a red dot, or open a part below.

image.alt: The full dashboard, with numbered parts

parts.title: Signal
parts.body: The small gauge at the top left shows your mobile signal, from 0 to 4 bars.

parts.title: RAM
parts.body: The small gauge at the top right shows how much of the phone's memory is in use.

parts.title: The big gauge
parts.body: It shows one of three things: power, CPU clock or GPS speed (see the modes above). Tap it on your home screen, or use the Big gauge tile in Quick Settings, to switch. The digits above the needle show the same value.

parts.title: Warning lights
parts.body:
Four lights on the big gauge. Each one can be switched off in the style's settings.

  • Low battery: at or below the low battery level, 15 % unless you change it.
  • Bluetooth: while Bluetooth is on.
  • High temperature: when the battery is hotter than 45 °C, unless you change it.
  • Low temperature: when the battery is colder than 0 °C, unless you change it.

parts.title: Date and time
parts.body: The LCD under the big gauge. The time format, date order, separators and seconds are all in the style's settings.

parts.title: Wi-Fi
parts.body: The strength of your Wi-Fi signal. Under it, a status line reads CONNECTED (with the link speed in Mbps), NO NETWORK, MOBILE DATA or DISABLED. The ON light is green on Wi-Fi and yellow on mobile data.

parts.title: Battery
parts.body: How full your battery is. The LOW light comes on at the low battery level, and the green bolt lights while the phone charges. The small dial shows the battery's temperature, from low (C) to high (H).

band.title: Your readings stay on your phone
band.text: Nothing the gauges read is sent anywhere. Your location is used only for the speed in GPS mode, and only while the wallpaper is on screen. Future's music, calls and messages are read on the phone and stay there.
